hero.name: Prabesh Amgain
hero.lede: I build intelligent, human-centered software — from Gemini-powered platforms to tools that make learning and reading faster, clearer and more beautiful.

about.label: 01 — Profile
about.heading: A curious mind building with intelligence.
about.lead: I'm a computer science student and self-driven AI builder from Kathmandu. Since joining GitHub in June 2025 I've shipped 23 public repositories — spanning AI platforms, developer tools and study aids.
about.body: My work sits at the intersection of machine intelligence and human experience: rapid AI experimentation with Gemini, instant manga colorization, interactive search-algorithm visualizers, and a phishing detector trained to keep people safe online. Alongside the builds, I keep a rigorous academic practice in data structures, operating systems, databases and the theory of computation.
